name: Birth Rite
source:
Rhea has just become a mother on an island with a strange custom: the islanders must devour their firstborn children. Will she be able to save her own child?

[From [url=http://globalgamejam.org/2016/games/birth-rite] Global Game Jam[/url]]
translation:
瑞亚刚刚成为一名母亲，岛上有一个奇怪的习俗：岛民必须吃掉他们的长子。她能拯救自己的孩子吗？

[来自[url=http://globalgamejam.org/2016/games/birth-rite] Global Game Jam[/url]]
